title: Predicting the Premier League Season Through Data Science
summary: A data-science forecast of the 2026/27 Premier League built from player quality, five-season club history and three deliberately different simulation engines.
key_takeaway: Arsenal and Manchester City form one title tier, separated by only half a percentage point; model disagreement is evidence to interpret, not noise to hide.
